agenda_text:
BELMONT SHORE PARKING AND BUSINESS
  IMPROVEMENT AREA ADVISORY AGENDA
  THURSDAY, MAY 16, 2024
  5365 2ND STREET
  FIRE STATION 8 COMMUNITY ROOM, 9:00 AM

Matthew Peterson, Chair  Jodi Meade, Commissioner
Karen Blair, Vice Chair  Aaron Tofani, Commissioner
Ryan Hofman, Commissioner  David Witzling, Commissioner
Jann Kronick-Gath, Commissioner

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

ANNOUNCEMENTS

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-53366  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the meeting held April 18, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-53367  Recommendation to receive and file a financial report for the period ending April
  2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-53368  Recommendation to receive and file the Long Beach Transit Employee Bus Pass
  Program Status for April 2024.

  Suggested Action:

4.  24-53369  Recommendation to set Community Facilities District No. 2007-2 (Belmont Shore)
  Fiscal Year 2025 assessment rate at $0.14 per square foot, and request staff to
  prepare the necessary documents for City Council approval.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  24-53371  Recommendation to approve Public Work's staff to assist in replacing the ropes for
  the flag poles on 2nd street.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  24-53373  Recommendation to discuss Conservation Corps working hours and the potential of
  having Conservation Corps employees work later during the afternoon.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  5365 2ND STREET
  FIRE STATION 8 COMMUNITY ROOM, 9:00 AM

7.  24-53375  Recommendation to discuss future items on the June 2024 Agenda.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Belmont Shore Parking and Business Improvement Area Advisory
Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their
comments unless extended by the Chair.

ADJOURNMENT

I, Teri A. Luce, Asst Admin Analyst, Public Works, certify that the agenda was posted not less than
72 hours prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans
with Disabilities Act, please contact Teri A. Luce at Teri.Luce@LongBeach.gov.
